rule.name: LoopVariableUnused
rule.message: This loop never uses its loop variable, but its body reads a fixed element of the iterated collection (xs.get(0), xs[0]), so every iteration reads the same element. Use the variable instead: for (String name : names) context.getBean(name, type), delegates.get(i).handle(ctx). If the loop only repeats work, name the variable ignored (for (Item ignored : items)) or use a plain counter.
